scope: Operator execution policies only; native hardware provenance remains in parameter_source_audit.json.
hash_convention: sha256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON: ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon)

vector_serial_policy_v1.title: 独立 Vector 串行执行与 UB 服务假设
vector_serial_policy_v1.verification: Explicit analytical policy; no published or measured UB bandwidth claim

normalization_serial_policy_v1.title: RMSNorm/Softmax 分行分阶段执行与归约依赖假设
normalization_serial_policy_v1.verification: Explicit coarse work and storage policy; no silicon calibration claim

ascend_ub_read_bpc.decision: Fixed uncalibrated 64*4 B/cycle UB service; only independent Ascend Vector uses it.

ascend_ub_write_bpc.decision: Fixed uncalibrated 64*4 B/cycle UB service; only independent Ascend Vector uses it.

configs/execution/vector.json.conditions: Separate execution profile; native hardware parameter counts/hashes unchanged. TSP/CIM share one policy.

fp32_sub_cost.decision: One scalar SUB modeled as one basic equivalent operation; shares native Vector/VXM budget, not calibrated.

fp32_max_cost.decision: One pairwise MAX comparison/selection modeled as one equivalent operation; not calibrated.

fp32_rcp_cost.decision: Algorithmic proxy: one seed-equivalent operation plus two Newton-style updates of two MUL and one SUB each: 1+2*3=7. Seed accuracy and numerical result are not modeled; not native reciprocal timing.

reduction_round_cycles.decision: Minimum compute dependency interval per tree level or cross-tile binary merge. Total compute is max(weighted-work cycles, this value); memory and startup charged separately. Not a measured shuffle or lane-network latency.
